name: @lyku/para-kit
description: The P9 fullstack projection for Para sync (spec ch. 08 §13.7–§13.8, plan step 5): emits the escape-analyzed <file>.server.pts artifacts and the sync manifest, hosts one createServerSource per live subscription key, and bridges SyncEnvelopes over SSE with a client SseTransport implementing the para-sync dumb-pipe contract. SvelteKit-shaped handlers; the artifact contract is host-agnostic. Pre-release: API may change before 0.1.0.
